a_replay_parity.evidence: A replay staging failed before tile generation and inference; one allowed staging retry is consumed.

trusted_independent_val_audit.evidence: 0 independently verified trail or distractor samples; no trusted VAL traces were frozen.

input_registration_and_pixel_identity.evidence: Raw source files and tile indexes match, but regenerated tile image/class-map hashes do not.

split_footprint_independence.evidence: The recovered split has 2.34 km2 summed pairwise cross-split tile-footprint overlap; 0.401 km2 overlaps Park City VAL and held-out footprints. This is geometric footprint area; nodata validity is unknown.

local_batch_12_fit.evidence: The Intel Arc 130V 8 GB batch-12 fit smoke check ran out of memory.

t4q-labelmask.required_gate: confirmed incorrect positive supervision in at least 8 TRAIN windows across 2 blocks and at least 1% of affected-area A-positive ground area
t4q-labelmask.evidence: No blinded independent TRAIN adjudication; verified qualifying windows and area are both 0/unknown.

t4q-labeladd.required_gate: at least 250 m of independently verified omitted tread across 8 TRAIN windows and 2 blocks
t4q-labeladd.evidence: No independent dated trail traces; qualifying length and windows are both 0/unknown.

t4q-hardneg.required_gate: verified recurring distractors in at least 8 TRAIN windows across 2 blocks and in trusted VAL evidence
t4q-hardneg.evidence: No verified distractor windows or frozen trusted VAL references.

t4q-weatherdrop.required_gate: at least 6 verified Park City snow and 6 bare VAL windows with tread; snow recall gap at least 0.10; terrain ablation loss at least 0.05; optical ablation within 0.05 without increased distractor burden
t4q-weatherdrop.evidence: No independently adjudicated snow/bare corridor windows and no A modality diagnostics.

t4q-tversky.required_gate: clear-image distractors in at least 6 trusted VAL windows across 2 blocks and no actionable label, alignment, or imagery defect
t4q-tversky.evidence: No trusted VAL distractor audit; registration and tile-pixel identity remain unverified.

decision: No training arm is justified. Preserve A and do not treat failed staging as a model result.
reopen_when: A replay parity and tile-pixel identities are verified in an authorized run.
Dated independent Park City trail references and ML reuse permission are obtained.
Blinded trusted VAL audit meets the applicable arm's sample/block thresholds.
Cross-split tile-footprint overlap is reported and excluded from trusted audit windows.
